sn50.1-12:1.1: The five powers are practically identical to the five spiritual faculties ([sn48.43]()). The 108 discourses in this Saṁyutta are merely stock passages and abbreviations. The analysis lacking here is found in a series of Suttas at [an5.13]()–16. | The Chinese version in SA gathers many of the discourses on different sets of “powers” that the Pali scatters about the canon.
